[h2][b]Patch notes : Snapping/Variants[/b][/h2]

[h3]
> Snapping/Variants[/h3]
- It is now possible to activate snapping between certain objects such as wall modules in order to simplify the layout or creation of decor for your interiors or servers.
- Certain objects also have variants which allow a wider choice without the need to have several distinct objects in your inventory.
- These 2 options do not require being in editor mode and can be used as long as you place a compatible object.

[h3]
> ADDITIONS[/h3]

+ Usable and consumable items can now be placed like furniture on land

notes.title: Update 1.58.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patch notes : Technical and graphic evolutions[/b][/h2]

[h3]
> NEWS[/h3]

+ Added a test map
[list][*]When creating a server, you can select "Test Map".
[*]This map aims to allow players to test the game's different systems easily and quickly without having to load a complete map.[/list]
+ Native integration of the Essentials plugin
+ Integration of cents into the economy
+ Servers can set the price of gasoline in the roleplay.json file and with the /setfuel command
+ Servers can set the breakage probability of streetlights in the roleplay.json file and with the /setlightbreakprob command
+ Added a trigger under the map that teleports players and stores vehicles in the garage
+ Added a key to (de)activate the admin service (configurable in the game options)
+ A street light can randomly break down every minute
+ Electricians can repair broken street lights
+ Added a button to turn off the weather vane on the bus tablet
+ Added accessories to the Leaf Golster 1981
+ Addition of a new object “Reporting plot” Id -> 1626 (Available at the IGPN)
+ Added a new item "Office partition" Id -> 1627 (Purchasable at the Presto Depot, Professional category)
+ Added a new item "Wooden wardrobe" Id -> 1628 (Purchasable at the Presto Depot, Bedroom category)

[h3]> FIXES[/h3]

- Created vehicles have the default shine at 85%
- Fixed the /tpveh command which did not take into account fake vehicles
- Clothing creation commands now support a number argument in the 3rd position
- Added a notification when the selected player's inventory is full during a giveaway with the admin panel
- Fix on the Leaf Golster 🔻
[list]
[*]Fixed the Leaf Golster steering wheel
[*]Fixed Leaf Golster wipers
[*]Fixed front door interactions in Leaf Golster interior view[/list]
- Correction of the Vario Brinx wheels
- Vario Brinx logo which disappears during the fake
- Fixed several car icons at the dealership
- Fixed the portal of land 386
- Fixed the “Left Deviation” panel which was not recoverable
- Optimization of vegetation

[H3]> INFORMATION[/h3]

The Essentials plugin is no longer necessary to operate your server correctly. You can therefore [b]delete the Essentials folder after recovering your server configurations[/b].
You will now be able to completely configure your server via the Config folder located at the root of your server. You will find there in particular [b]after the first launch of your server[/b] the following files:
[list]
[*][b]server.json[/b] which allows you to configure the server core (display name, slots, whitelist, ...)
[*][b]roleplay.json[/b] which allows you to configure the roleplay part of your server (starting money, maximum number of properties, ...)
[*][b]carDealership.json[/b] which allows you to configure the car dealer (position, models and sales prices, etc.)
[*][b]announcer.json[/b] which allows you to configure automatic announcements for your server
[/list]
The announcement system has been redone and now allows you to configure several announcements. The time configured on an ad represents the duration between the broadcasts of the previous ad and the corresponding ad.

! If you already own a server, you will need to [b]launch it for the first time[/b] after the update to [b]generate the new configuration files[/b] then [b]launch it again [/b] after having edited them so that the [b]modifications are taken into account[/b]!
